notes: The video has a quality list now: the size chip in the header opens every size this video offers, from 360p to 4K, and the size you pick is remembered for the next video. At the top sizes the picture and the same video soundtrack arrive separately and are played together, so a bigger picture still sounds like the video and not the song.

The FULL button is a landscape button: it turns the player full-bleed, asks the phone for landscape, and keeps the app own play, pause, quality and close controls on the glass instead of handing the screen to the browser.
Changing size keeps the second you were on, and a size the phone refuses falls back to the best size that carries its own sound and says so instead of going black.
Limits, stated plainly: a high size can be large, so the player uses it directly and nothing above 64 MB is read into memory. Nothing is downloaded and nothing is kept.
